objective: Close a formal-evidence gap where realtime reflection probes and native 4K stills could share identical scene/light/material hashes while global Built-in render policy, quality tier or effective texture mip residency changed between them.

finding.gap: The existing reflection lighting fingerprint already bound high-impact shadow/LOD/AA/anisotropy values, renderer/material/texture identity, lightmaps and probe configuration, but it did not bind the complete GraphicsSettings/QualitySettings project state, active GraphicsTier/render-pipeline identity, globalTextureMipmapLimit or renderer-bound texture streaming/mipmap-limit-group residency.
finding.visualRisk: A legal quality/tier/pipeline or texture-residency change can alter Standard-shader/reflection behavior or remove high-resolution texture mips without changing material bindings. That can contaminate Material/PBR, Lighting/Reflections, Texture/Microdetail, Cinematic and Temporal/LOD review while leaving previous scene hashes apparently coherent.
finding.priorityReason: This affects the evidence used to score several categories and can silently reduce 100% crop detail, so it was prioritized over adding speculative geometry while no Unity Runner/render evidence is available.

commits.summary: Add fail-closed render policy evidence fingerprint
Bind render policy to reflection lighting evidence
Align render policy risks with canonical visual gate IDs

implementation.reflectionIntegration: QualityBlockReflectionLightingStateFingerprint.BuildCurrentSha256 now folds the validated render-policy SHA-256 into the same request/poll/completion/pre-still fingerprint already enforced by QualityBlockReflectionProbeAwaiter.
failClosedRules: Built-in Render Pipeline required; current/default/quality SRP assets must be null
renderer-bound mipmapped Texture2D assets may not use streaming mipmaps
renderer-bound mipmapped Texture2D assets may not inherit a mipmap-limit group unless ignoreMipmapLimit=true
current quality level and active GraphicsTier are fingerprinted
serialized GraphicsSettings and QualitySettings project state are SHA-256-bound
current/default/quality render-pipeline asset identities are SHA-256-bound
active renderer/material/property Texture2D residency state is ordered and fingerprinted

implementationReadiness.reasonUnchanged: The new fail-closed policy is source-complete but cannot earn the remaining runtime-readiness points without Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/execution and native evidence.

expectedImpactAfterActualRender.material_pbr_physical_plausibility: medium; prevents tier/pipeline/residency drift from changing angular material response between probe and still
expectedImpactAfterActualRender.lighting_shadows_reflections: high; proves reflection cubemaps and stills use one Built-in graphics/quality policy
expectedImpactAfterActualRender.texture_microdetail_texel_fidelity: high; forbids global top-mip removal and renderer-bound mip streaming in formal evidence
expectedImpactAfterActualRender.cinematic_image_quality: medium; prevents quality/pipeline policy drift from contaminating exposure/color/reflection review
expectedImpactAfterActualRender.temporal_lod_aliasing_stability: medium-high; removes camera-dependent renderer texture residency as a source of formal temporal shimmer

runtimeFailureInjectionPlan: After reflection request set QualitySettings.globalTextureMipmapLimit=1; next observed poll must abort on policy mismatch.
Enable streamingMipmaps on one renderer-bound Texture2D; formal policy validation must fail before accepted capture.
Assign a mipmap-limit group without ignoreMipmapLimit; formal policy validation must fail.
Switch quality level or active Built-in graphics tier after reflection request; the policy hash must drift and invalidate the epoch.
Assign an SRP asset; the policy validator must fail before reflection/still evidence is accepted.
nextBlocker: No Unity Runner or native screenshots are available. The next useful step is Unity 6000.3.0f1 compilation plus the failure injections above; if real screenshots appear, stop speculative source expansion and score/fix those pixels first.
